name: io.github.sepehr071/snapptrip-mcp
title: SnappTrip Hotels and Flights
description: Read-only SnappTrip: Iranian hotel search, rooms, reviews, calendar prices and domestic flights.

environmentVariables.name: SNAPPTRIP_MCP_PROXY
environmentVariables.description: Optional HTTP proxy URL for the SnappTrip requests; system proxy settings are ignored. Also accepts a comma-separated list: one is used until it gets blocked or fails to connect, then the next.
